verdict.rationale: Noise suppression and audio filtering are a fair question for a voice-agent platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions noise cancellation, audio filtering or background-noise handling. Support for third-party STT providers like Deepgram and Azure is an adjacent provider capability, not a documented Bolna noise-suppression feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls
